extraction.notes: Read in full (text pages 1-8; page 8 is blank). The cover is dated February 2024; the register gives 2024-07 from the World Bank document number. Text-file page numbers are one higher than the printed page numbers (text page 2 is printed page 1). The executive summary has no section headings on text pages 2-3, so the section is given as 'Executive Summary'; on text pages 4-7 the recommendation group heading (Laws and regulations, Institutions, Digital data infrastructure, Human capital) is printed at the foot of each page and is used as the section, with the recommendation number within the group as paragraph. Conversion problem: on text pages 2-3 the two-column layout breaks one sentence ('A factor that remains' at the foot of page 3 continues 'critical to the success of embracing open data...' at the top of the same page), so that item quotes the fragment and is flagged possible_misread. Footnote reference markers ('2', '3') sit inside two recommendation sentences on text pages 5 and 6; they are kept because the converted text runs on, and noted on the item; the footnotes themselves are not quoted. All content concerns data governance, AI and digital public infrastructure (theme scope); no Chapter 2 content. Left out: framing sentences on the value of public sector data and the DTS vision; the general description of digital public infrastructure; the sentence on MDAs' legal mandate to connect to the government cloud (it carries a footnote marker, and the mandates are only cited in the footnote); the DTS directions on interoperability as reported (the DTS is held as MDA-GOV-2023-001); the projection that Moldova could be among Europe's leaders by 2030; the recommendation on digital and data literacy programmes for citizens (digital skills not linked to an in-scope recommendation). Doubtful for the analyst: the recommendation on public sector IT staff conditions (human resources for digital government) and the training of public sector staff in data skills, both kept with theme_doubtful; the legislative review recommendation mentions digital financial services (out of scope, R22) alongside data protection and e-identification, and is kept for the in-scope parts. Second-pass check (PC-05) by checker-GOV8b on 5 November 2026: 2 items added (review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MDA-IO-2024-003.csv).
